description: Land Acquisition - Dematahettigoda, Unella, Thihagoda D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and original claimants, which falls squarely under the "Land and property-related matters" category (Type 4). There is no government personnel information, organizational changes, or other specialized content that would warrant a different classification.
